nodes.question: Who needs an account to use the app?

options.label: Nobody logs in — one person uses it on their own device
Exactly one person logs in (the owner)
Several people log in, possibly with different powers

nodes.question: Do different people have different powers?

options.label: Everyone who logs in can do everything
An owner/admin plus staff with fewer powers
Admins define their own roles and permissions

nodes.question: Do outside parties (customers, clients, vendors) use the app directly?

options.label: No — outsiders only receive emails/PDFs/messages
They open a secure link (no account needed)
They have their own accounts and log in

nodes.question: How do additional people get access?

options.label: No additional people
An admin invites them
Anyone can sign up themselves

nodes.question: How do people sign in?

options.label: No sign-in
Email + password
Email link, no password
Google/Microsoft sign-in
Company single sign-on (SAML/OIDC)

nodes.question: What happens when two people edit the same thing at once?

options.label: Rare; the last save wins
Common; the app must prevent or merge conflicting edits

nodes.question: Do you need a record of who changed what and when?

options.label: No
Just created/updated by whom and when
A full, viewable history of every change

nodes.question: Where is it used?

options.label: In a browser, on desktop and phone
In a browser, mostly on phones
As an installed phone app
As an installed desktop app

nodes.question: Do you start with existing data?

options.label: Start empty
Import from a spreadsheet/CSV once
Migrate from another tool

nodes.question: Do people need to get their data out?

options.label: No
Download lists as CSV/Excel
Full export and/or an API

nodes.question: When something is deleted, what really happens?

options.label: It's gone
It's archived and can be restored
Records are never deleted, only voided/cancelled

nodes.question: How much data will there be?

options.label: Hundreds of records
Tens of thousands
Millions

nodes.question: Does it need to connect to other tools?

options.label: No
A few key ones (e.g., accounting, payments, calendar)
Many — it needs a public API / webhooks

nodes.question: Languages and regions?

options.label: One language, one country
Several languages
Several countries (taxes, formats, currencies)

nodes.question: Can files/photos be attached to things?

options.label: No
Yes — upload and download
Yes — with previews, versions, and sharing

nodes.question: Is any part visible to the public without logging in?

options.label: No
Yes — marketing/landing pages only
Yes — content people create is public

nodes.question: Does it hold data with special legal handling (health, payment cards, minors)?

options.label: Ordinary business data
Personal data needing consent/retention care (GDPR-like)
Regulated data (health, cards, finance)

nodes.question: How long is data kept?

options.label: Until someone deletes it
Auto-removed after a set period
Each business sets its own policy

nodes.question: Can each business customize the app?

options.label: No — everyone gets the same thing
Branding and templates (logo, colors, wording)
Custom fields and workflows

nodes.question: What do people need to see across many records?

options.label: Sortable, filterable lists
A dashboard with totals and counts
Custom reports people build themselves

nodes.question: Who creates bookings?

options.label: Only staff, on behalf of customers (phone, front desk)
Customers book themselves online without an account (they get a confirmation link)
Customers book from their own account and see their history

nodes.question: What is actually being reserved?

options.label: A person's time (stylist, doctor, consultant)
A room, table, court, or piece of equipment
Both at once — a person and a room/asset must be free

nodes.question: How are bookable services defined?

options.label: One kind of booking with a fixed length
A menu of services, each with its own length and price
A menu plus add-ons/extras that change length and price

nodes.question: Where do open time slots come from?

options.label: Fixed business hours for everyone
Each staff member/resource has its own weekly hours plus days off
Whatever is free in each person's external calendar

nodes.question: Is there gap time between appointments?

options.label: No — back to back
A fixed gap after every booking
Different setup/cleanup time per service

nodes.question: How many people can a single slot hold?

options.label: One booking per slot (1:1 appointments)
Several people per slot up to a capacity (classes, tours)
Some services are 1:1, some are group sessions

nodes.question: Can a booking repeat (every Tuesday, monthly)?

options.label: No — each booking is made separately
Yes — a series is created and can be edited as one or per occurrence

nodes.question: What happens when the wanted time is full?

options.label: Nothing — they pick another time
They join a waitlist and staff call them if something opens
They join a waitlist and get an automatic offer when a slot frees up

nodes.question: Who can cancel a booking, and until when?

options.label: Customers cancel any time, no consequence
Customers cancel freely until a cut-off (e.g., 24h); after that it counts as late
Only staff can cancel; customers must contact the business

nodes.question: Can customers move a booking themselves?

options.label: Yes — up to the same cut-off as cancellations
Yes — any time before it starts
No — they contact the business

nodes.question: What happens when someone doesn't turn up?

options.label: Staff mark it as a no-show; nothing else
A no-show fee is charged to the card on file
No-shows are counted and repeat offenders must prepay or are blocked

nodes.question: Is money taken when booking?

options.label: No — free, or paid in person/elsewhere
Paid in person; the app just records the price and payment status
A deposit is paid online to confirm; the rest later
The full price is paid online at booking

nodes.question: Is a booking confirmed instantly, or does someone approve it first?

options.label: Instantly confirmed if the slot is free
It's a request until staff accept or decline it

nodes.question: How are customers reminded before their booking?

options.label: No reminders
An email some hours/days before
Email and SMS, and customers can confirm or cancel from the reminder

nodes.question: Does it talk to Google/Outlook/Apple calendars?

options.label: No — the app is the calendar
Bookings are pushed to staff calendars (one way)
Two way — busy time in their external calendar also blocks availability here

nodes.question: Are customers and staff in the same time zone?

options.label: Yes — one local time zone everywhere
No — times must be shown in each person's own zone

nodes.question: What must the customer fill in when booking?

options.label: Just name and contact details
A few fixed questions (notes, preferences, allergies)
Different questions per service, set up by the business

nodes.question: Where do bookings take place?

options.label: One location
Several locations, each with its own staff and hours
Online/video or at the customer's address

nodes.question: Do staff also add bookings and block time by hand?

options.label: No — everything comes through the online flow
Yes — walk-ins, phone bookings, holds, and blocked time

nodes.question: Does the price of a service vary?

options.label: One price per service
Varies by who does it or when (senior stylist, peak hours)
Quoted per booking by staff

nodes.question: How much is kept about each customer?

options.label: Just the contact details typed for each booking
A customer record with all past and future visits
A customer record plus private staff notes and preferences

nodes.question: Who edits staff working hours and time off?

options.label: Only the owner/admin
Each staff member edits their own hours; admin sees all

nodes.question: When a stylist profile is removed, what happens to their existing future appointments?

options.label: Prevent removal while future bookings exist
Force reassignment to another stylist
Cancel affected appointments and notify clients

nodes.question: What happens when two clients try to book the same stylist slot at the same time?

options.label: First to confirm gets it; other sees slot taken
Slot is held/locked while one is booking

nodes.question: How are duplicate booking submissions (double-click, retry) handled?

options.label: Detect and collapse into one appointment
Create each; staff clean up

nodes.question: How is availability computed around salon hours, stylist working days, and time off at day/month boundaries?

options.label: Slot must fit fully within salon hours AND stylist hours AND outside time off
Only salon hours enforced; stylist checks manually

nodes.question: Can a cancelled appointment be reinstated/undone?

options.label: No — must rebook (slot may be gone)
Restore only if the slot is still open

nodes.question: Can receptionists override booking rules (book during time off, past cutoff, double-book) that clients cannot?

options.label: Staff bound by same integrity rules
Staff may override with a warning

nodes.question: If a booking is confirmed but the reminder/notification fails to send, what happens?

options.label: Booking stands; reminder retried/flagged
Flag to staff to contact client manually

nodes.question: How does a service's duration map to the booking grid and stylist availability?

options.label: Block exact service length; next slot starts after
Round up to fixed slot increments (e.g., 15/30 min)

cards.context: You want to see how your salon is doing across many bookings and clients

options.label: A dashboard with totals and counts
options.scenario: You open one screen and see today's numbers at a glance: total bookings, no-shows, and busiest stylists, all as simple totals you cannot dig into further.

options.label: Sortable, filterable lists
options.scenario: You see full lists of every booking and client, then sort and filter them yourself to find exactly the appointments, stylists, or dates you care about.

options.label: Custom reports people build themselves
options.scenario: You build your own summaries by choosing what to measure and group, saving views like revenue per stylist or bookings by service for whenever you need them.

also_sets: Download your lists to a spreadsheet
A booking is confirmed instantly when the slot is free
